reviewScope: All 325 JPEG/HEIC stills reviewed chronologically in 5 contact sheets; shortlisted candidates reviewed again at up to 492 pixels, with covers at 1600 pixels.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF capture timestamps. OffsetTimeOriginal is retained where present; filenames are not used to infer the day. Unoffset camera timestamps are preserved without assuming synchronized clocks.
locationNotes: Original GPS, visible landmarks, readable signs and neighbouring frames establish places. Exact original GPS is not copied into this manifest or published derivatives.
Atlanta and Vietnam originals lack usable GPS; location labels rely on visible landmarks and broader collection context. California originals supply GPS for selected sites.
Nikon and phone clock times in Vietnam are preserved as recorded; they are not treated as synchronized. All selected dates agree with their original capture date.
No itinerary was present. No completed archive for this collection was present at review time; the existing extracted originals were reviewed without extraction or renaming.
Originals, videos, RAW files, HEIC originals and review sheets stay outside the website and R2. Only selected metadata-free WebP derivatives are exported.
criteria: Choose distinct clear landscapes, architecture, interiors, wildlife, food and candid daily life; compare bursts and avoid padding limited days.
Group by actual local capture date and location; shorter sections are retained for isolated daily-life photographs.
Keep each cover once in its album and daily count, without repeating it in the gallery.
Preserve original framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation, omit EXIF/XMP, and export quality-84 WebP at 2000 pixels or 2400 for covers.
Local people, performances, crowds and incidental visitors are allowed. peoplePhotoSources is a conservative list to support later review without identifying or matching faces.
omissionReasons: Repeated scenes and near-identical bursts, weaker framing, blurred and badly exposed frames, and most posed portraits.
Conference slides, work records, routine transport logistics and long repeated road or flight sequences.
Videos and RAW derivatives are outside the selected WebP photo essay.
